reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model PC-10, which is not a recalled model. The recalled model is PA-10, so the unit is not part of this recall.
Model mismatch is the controlling check; the typed model matches the label reading, so no typo exception applies.
Date code 2126 is in range, and the purchase (2022-01-17 at www.usa.yamaha.com, inside the sale window) passes, but these do not cure the model mismatch.
No duplicate claims found, and no destruction photo is required for this remedy.
